judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The petitioner has filed this writ petition, styled as public interest litigation, seeking issuance of a mandamus to direct the respondents to evict the illegal encroachments all along the stretch of Chiteri Water bodies, Erikarai and its adjoining Tank Bund and Government Poramboke land, Tank promboke land and its appurtenance located at Survey No. 297/A on the Western land of S. Nos. 293 and 296/B at Gopalapuram, Thandurai Village Chitterai, Township Block at No. 9/26, Pattabiram Avadi Taluk, Thiruvallur District on permanent basis and further direct the respondents to effectively keep a vigil by way of periodical inspection and police patrolling so as to avert encroachments in future.

2. When the matter was taken up for hearing, learned counsel for the respondents submitted that, upon survey, it was found that are 314 encroachers and, therefore, notices were issued to them. Objections have been submitted by the encroachers and upon due consideration, the same were rejected and final eviction notices were issued on 23-2-2026 to the encroachers in Form-III. They further submitted that eviction proceedings shall be concluded at the earliest possible, in accordance with law.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner urged that the proceedings may be kept pending and the court may monitor the proceedings. However, in view of the aforesaid submission made by learned counsel for the respondents that final eviction notices were issued on 23-2-2026 and the proceedings shall be concluded at the earliest, we are not inclined to keep this petition pending.

4. In such view of the matter, the writ petition is disposed of with a direction to the respondents to conclude the aforesaid exercise as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, and ensure that all the encroachments are removed. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, interim application stands closed.
